title: Founder's Guide to the Built Website

sections.heading: Open the Website Folder
sections.text: Navigate to the 'phase3_step3_site' folder to access the built website files.

sections.heading: Value Proposition Section
sections.text: The page shows the bilingual Arabic and English template pack for freelance designers in Egypt and the MENA region, with no subscriptions and no client data collection.

sections.heading: Features Section
sections.text: The page lists the ability to track client projects, invoices sent, and revision rounds using Notion and Google Sheets.

sections.heading: Evidence Section
sections.text: The page highlights the founder's skills in design and tools, and the bilingual support.

sections.heading: Price Section
sections.text: The page includes a placeholder for USD 100 for the template pack (to be set in Phase 4).

sections.heading: FAQ Section
sections.text: The page has a FAQ section with common questions about the template pack and its features.

sections.heading: Policy Links Section
sections.text: The page includes policy links to privacy and terms (to be drafted in Phase 4).

sections.heading: Demo Sign-Up Box
sections.text: The page has a demo sign-up box with a label showing the founder's call-to-action.

sections.heading: Placeholders
sections.text: Placeholders include price details and policies until Phase 4, and the demo sign-up box that sends nothing.

sections.heading: What the Page Does Not Do
sections.text: The page does not include payment integration, user accounts, or dynamic content. It is a static template pack for tracking and organizing client information.
